name: narasi-karhutla
description: Remotion explainer that narrates the 2026 Indonesian fire season over the smoke-video animation

scripts.build:uang: remotion render Uang out/ke-mana-uangnya.mp4 && remotion still InfografisUang1 out/InfografisUang1.png && remotion still InfografisUang2 out/InfografisUang2.png
scripts.build:biaya: remotion render Biaya out/harga-nikel.mp4 && remotion still InfografisBiaya1 out/InfografisBiaya1.png && remotion still InfografisBiaya2 out/InfografisBiaya2.png
scripts.build:air: remotion render Air out/jejak-perairan.mp4 && remotion still InfografisAir1 out/InfografisAir1.png && remotion still InfografisAir2 out/InfografisAir2.png
scripts.build:tambang: remotion render Tambang out/jejak-tambang.mp4 && remotion still InfografisTambang1 out/InfografisTambang1.png && remotion still InfografisTambang2 out/InfografisTambang2.png
scripts.build:infografis: remotion still Infografis1 out/Infografis1.png && remotion still Infografis2 out/Infografis2.png && remotion still InfografisEN1 out/InfografisEN1.png && remotion still InfografisEN2 out/InfografisEN2.png
scripts.build:api: remotion render Api out/api-gambut-sawit.mp4 && remotion still InfografisApi1 out/InfografisApi1.png && remotion still InfografisApi2 out/InfografisApi2.png
scripts.build:api-en: remotion render ApiEN out/api-gambut-sawit-en.mp4 && remotion still InfografisApiEN1 out/InfografisApiEN1.png && remotion still InfografisApiEN2 out/InfografisApiEN2.png
scripts.build:infografis-api: remotion still InfografisApi1 out/InfografisApi1.png && remotion still InfografisApi2 out/InfografisApi2.png && remotion still InfografisApiEN1 out/InfografisApiEN1.png && remotion still InfografisApiEN2 out/InfografisApiEN2.png
scripts.build:infografis-sawit: remotion still InfografisSawit out/InfografisSawit.png && remotion still InfografisSawitEN out/InfografisSawitEN.png
scripts.build:infografis-sawit2030: remotion still InfografisSawit2030 out/InfografisSawit2030.png && remotion still InfografisSawit2030EN out/InfografisSawit2030EN.png
